card.name: The word time after each or every
card.fires_on: The word "time" right after "every" or "each" when it begins a clause about repeating an action, such as each new prescription or each new patch.

modes.label: every time prescribed
modes.description: "time" after "every" in counseling advice given whenever a medicine is prescribed.
modes.example: caregivers every<< time>> these medicines are prescribed.

modes.label: each time new patch
modes.description: "time" after "each" in directions to change the application site with each new patch.
modes.example: Select a different application site each<< time>> a new XELSTRYM transder
